item.title: An Introduction to YOLO26
item.description:
📝 YOLO26 is a multi-task model family designed to handle a broad range of computer vision tasks, including object detection, instance segmentation, image classification, pose estimation, and oriented object detection. For other model task types, visit YOLO26 Github. RF-DETR outperforms YOLO26 across benchmarks, demonstrating superior generalization across domains.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.roboflow.com/yolo26/

item.description:
📝 Daybreak Cyber Partner Program⁠: Enabling security partners to scale the benefits to more organizations through our most capable models with trusted access in their products and services. item.title: Show HN: A pure ARM64 Assembly web server, now on Linux with CGI for no reason
item.description:
📝 ymawky -- web server in ARM assembly This is ymawky (yuh maw kee), a web server written entirely in ARM64 assembly. To see ymawky in action, start running ymawky with. ymawky is a static-file dynamic web server.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/imtomt/ymawky/tree/linux
